description: GCash-gated manual pre-orders (no payment gateway). DB: 0009_order_payment_enum.sql adds order_status labels awaiting_payment + payment_submitted (committed before 0010); 0010_order_payment.sql adds payment columns, changes orders.status default to awaiting_payment, creates the private payment-proofs Storage bucket + INSERT/SELECT policies, the submit_payment RPC, and the 4-arg transition_order overload (new whitelist pairs + payment stamping) with the stale 3-arg drop and guarded REVOKEs. API: new PaymentReview kind, extended Legal set + three-bucket ValidateTransition + pure ValidateSubmitPayment, SubmitPaymentRequest/OrderDto fields, Db.SubmitPaymentAsync + ApplyTransitionAsync 4-arg (actor) with payment columns, the POST /orders/{id}/payment endpoint + extended authorization, and the full test updates (renamed 9-pair sync test, six ApplyTransitionAsync tests gain actor, new transition/validation/payment tests). Frontend: api.submitPayment, Cart copy, OrderStatus payment step + both pre-payment cancels, Dashboard Payments surface, Admin OrdersPanel write scaffolding. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (reuses vendors.gcash_number/gcash_name). Corresponds to plan.md items 10-23.
steps: DB migration 0009: create supabase/migrations/0009_order_payment_enum.sql with EXACTLY two bare autocommitted statements — alter type public.order_status add value if not exists 'awaiting_payment'; and ... 'payment_submitted'; — no other statements (must commit before 0010 uses the labels).

DB migration 0010: create supabase/migrations/0010_order_payment.sql — add orders columns payment_method text not null default 'gcash', gcash_reference text, payment_screenshot_path text, payment_verified_at timestamptz, payment_verified_by uuid references public.profiles(id), payment_rejected_reason text, payment_submitted_at timestamptz; alter column status set default 'awaiting_payment'; insert the private 'payment-proofs' bucket (on conflict do nothing) + the payment_proofs_insert_owner and payment_proofs_select_visible policies (exact SQL from design §4.3 step 3, keyed off split_part(name,'/',1)::uuid; SELECT = student owner OR vendor owner via v.id=o.vendor_id and v.owner_id=auth.uid() OR admin); create submit_payment(p_id,p_reference,p_screenshot_path) SECURITY DEFINER (for-update lock, FH002 not found, FH001 if status<>'awaiting_payment', set reference/screenshot/payment_submitted_at=now()/status='payment_submitted'); create or replace transition_order(p_id,p_to,p_reason,p_actor) with p_actor LAST, the 4 new whitelist pairs, payment_verified_at/by on ->pending and payment_rejected_reason on ->awaiting_payment; drop function if exists public.transition_order(uuid,text,text); guarded REVOKEs on the 4-arg transition_order and on submit_payment(uuid,text,text) (0007 pattern).
OrderDomain.cs: add OrderStatuses.AwaitingPayment/PaymentSubmitted (+ include in All) and TransitionKind.PaymentReview.

OrderService.cs: add the 4 legal pairs to Legal; classify payment_submitted->pending and payment_submitted->awaiting_payment as PaymentReview and awaiting_payment->cancelled / payment_submitted->cancelled as StudentCancel in PlanTransition; rewrite ValidateTransition to the three-bucket predicate (reasonRequired = To is Cancelled or AwaitingPayment; required-if-missing, forbidden-otherwise, length<=ReasonMax); add pure ValidateSubmitPayment (gcashReference required, trimmed 4-40, digits/space/hyphen -> 422 field gcashReference; GcashRefMin=4/GcashRefMax=40; no screenshotPath check here).

OrderDtos.cs: add SubmitPaymentRequest(string? GcashReference, string? ScreenshotPath); add read-only OrderDto fields GcashReference, PaymentSubmittedAt, PaymentVerifiedAt, PaymentRejectedReason, PaymentScreenshotPath.

Db.cs: add SubmitPaymentAsync(Guid id, string reference, string? screenshotPath, CancellationToken) -> rpc/submit_payment with FH001->ILLEGAL_TRANSITION/FH002->NOT_FOUND mapping; add [JsonPropertyName("p_actor")] Guid Actor to TransitionRpcBody and change ApplyTransitionAsync to (OrderService, Guid orderId, string to, string? reason, Guid actor, CancellationToken ct) building new TransitionRpcBody(orderId,to,reason,actor); extend OrderRow/OrderRowDto/OrderState/OrderStateDto and ToOrderRow with the new payment columns.

DbSupabaseTests.cs: rename LegalTransitionSet_matches_0007_sql_whitelist -> LegalTransitionSet_matches_sql_whitelist, cite 0010 in the comment, set sqlWhitelist to the exact 9 pairs, make illegalSamples all-illegal (awaiting_payment->preparing, payment_submitted->ready, awaiting_payment->completed).

OrdersEndpoints.cs: map POST /orders/{id:guid}/payment -> SubmitPaymentAsync (auth; role student; load state; require state.StudentId==userId; run ValidateSubmitPayment; then the authoritative screenshotPath check: if non-null reject 422 field screenshotPath unless it equals $"{id}/{rest}" with non-empty rest; call db.SubmitPaymentAsync; return OrderDto). In TransitionAsync authorize PaymentReview for vendor owner OR admin; in the StudentCancel branch add admin ONLY when plan.From is AwaitingPayment or PaymentSubmitted; pass userId.Value as the actor arg. Extend ToOrderDto for the new fields.

Tests: update the six ApplyTransitionAsync_* tests in DbSupabaseTests.cs with the actor arg + assert p_actor in the serialized body of ApplyTransitionAsync_success_returns_ok, add SubmitPaymentAsync success+FH001/FH002 cases; add the 4 legal pairs + 3 illegal rows + classification tests to OrderServiceTransitionTests.cs (audit Illegal_transitions_rejected has none of the new legal pairs); add reason-rule tests to OrderServiceValidationTests.cs (required for ->cancelled/->awaiting_payment, forbidden for ->pending verify and forward moves, over-length rejected); create OrderServicePaymentTests.cs for ValidateSubmitPayment cases.
api.js: add submitPayment(id, { gcashReference, screenshotPath }) -> POST /orders/{id}/payment via the request helper.
Cart.jsx: replace the 'Pay cash upon pickup' block/copy and the .checkout__fine note to say GCash payment is required next; keep navigating to /order/:id on success.

OrderStatus.jsx + OrderStatus.css: extend fetchOrder select with gcash_reference, payment_submitted_at, payment_rejected_reason; add awaiting_payment/payment_submitted to STATE_UI + a leading 'Payment' tracker step + DB_STATUS_TO_STEP; awaiting_payment resolves getVendor (full list) and either shows the payment-details-unavailable message (vendor undefined or !gcashNumber) or the vendor gcashName/gcashNumber (NOT phone) + required reference input + optional screenshot file input (upload to 'payment-proofs' at `${order.uuid}/${filename}` first, fall back to reference-only on error, then submitPayment + refresh); render a Cancel order control on BOTH pre-payment branches reusing cancelOrder; show payment_rejected_reason on a rejected-back awaiting_payment; leave the isPending-only button unchanged; add status styles (orange/yellow, no blue).

Dashboard.jsx + Dashboard.css: extend loadOrders select with gcash_reference, payment_screenshot_path; add a payments bucket for payment_submitted (and a muted awaiting_payment group); add a Payments tab/section with pickup name, total, GCash reference, a 'View screenshot' signed-URL link (createSignedUrl(path,60); null-path -> 'No screenshot provided'), and Verify (->pending) / Reject (prompt reason ->awaiting_payment) / Cancel order (prompt required reason ->cancelled) buttons then loadOrders; awaiting_payment rows get Cancel only; add status styles (orange/yellow, no blue).

Admin.jsx + Admin.css: extend the admin orders SELECT to id, code, vendor_id, status, pickup_name, subtotal, total, placed_at, gcash_reference, payment_screenshot_path and key OrdersPanel rows by o.id (display o.code); pass onChanged=loadAll and setError to OrdersPanel; inside it import { transitionOrder } from '../lib/api' and implement its own per-row busy/disabled + reason prompts + error surfacing via setError, refreshing with onChanged(); payment_submitted rows -> Verify/Reject/Cancel, awaiting_payment rows -> Cancel only; 'View screenshot' via signed URL (null-path message); non-pre-payment rows stay read-only; add status styles (orange/yellow, no blue).
acceptance_criteria: 0009 contains only the two ADD VALUE statements; 0010 follows the 0007 RPC/REVOKE patterns, drops the stale 3-arg transition_order, and pins the storage SELECT policy as the exact SQL from design §4.3.
dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln compiles after the ApplyTransitionAsync signature change (endpoint call site + the six tests pass the new actor arg).
dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln passes: the renamed 9-pair sync test, the new legal/illegal/classification transition tests, the reason-rule tests, and OrderServicePaymentTests.

Placing a pre-order lands the order awaiting_payment and it is absent from the vendor Incoming queue; submitting an empty reference is rejected 422; a direct awaiting_payment->preparing is rejected ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.

The student payment step shows the vendor's dedicated GCash details (not phone) or the unavailable message; both pre-payment states expose a working Cancel order; vendor and admin can Verify/Reject/Cancel payment_submitted orders and Cancel awaiting_payment orders; 'View screenshot' opens a signed URL or shows the null-path message.
npm run build succeeds; no blue is introduced.
verification: dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln — all tests pass (78 baseline + new).
npm install (if needed) then npm run build — succeeds.
Review 0009/0010 against 0002/0007 for the enum split, the whitelist mirror, the dropped 3-arg overload, and the guarded REVOKEs.
findings:
DONE. GCash-gated manual pre-orders implemented end to end; FEAT-001's 0008 gcash_number/gcash_name columns reused. Verified from the worktree root: dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln succeeds (0 warn/0 err); dotnet test server/FoodHerons.sln passes 108/108 (78 baseline + 30 new); npm run build succeeds (node_modules already present from FEAT-002; chunk-size warning only, exit 0). No blue introduced.

DB: 0009_order_payment_enum.sql = ONLY the two bare `add value if not exists` statements (awaiting_payment, payment_submitted). 0010_order_payment.sql adds the 7 payment columns, sets orders.status default to 'awaiting_payment', creates the PRIVATE payment-proofs bucket (on conflict do nothing) + payment_proofs_insert_owner (student owner) and payment_proofs_select_visible (student owner OR vendor owner via v.id=o.vendor_id and v.owner_id=auth.uid() OR admin, keyed off split_part(name,'/',1)::uuid), the submit_payment RPC (FOR UPDATE lock, FH002 not-found, FH001 if status<>awaiting_payment, stamps reference/screenshot/payment_submitted_at=now()/status=payment_submitted) with guarded REVOKEs, and the 4-arg transition_order(p_id,p_to,p_reason,p_actor) with the 9-pair whitelist + payment_verified_at/by on ->pending + payment_rejected_reason on ->awaiting_payment, DROPs the stale 3-arg overload, and guarded REVOKEs on the 4-arg signature (0007 pattern). Applied migrations 0001-0007 untouched.

API: OrderStatuses gained AwaitingPayment/PaymentSubmitted (both in All); TransitionKind.PaymentReview added. OrderService.Legal = 9 pairs (made public so nothing else changed); PlanTransition classifies payment_submitted->pending/->awaiting_payment as PaymentReview and {pending,awaiting_payment,payment_submitted}->cancelled as StudentCancel; ValidateTransition rewritten to the 3-bucket predicate (reasonRequired = To is Cancelled or AwaitingPayment); pure ValidateSubmitPayment (gcashReference required, 4-40, digits/space/hyphen; GcashRefMin=4/Max=40). OrderDtos: SubmitPaymentRequest + 5 read-only OrderDto payment fields. Db.cs: SubmitPaymentAsync (FH001->ILLEGAL_TRANSITION/FH002->NOT_FOUND), TransitionRpcBody gained p_actor, ApplyTransitionAsync now (OrderService,orderId,to,reason,actor,ct) building new TransitionRpcBody(orderId,to,reason,actor); OrderRow/OrderRowDto/ToOrderRow extended (DTO payment props defaulted null so existing test JSON still deserializes). OrdersEndpoints: POST /orders/{id}/payment (auth; role student; ValidateSubmitPayment; authoritative screenshotPath check = must be `{id}/{rest}` non-empty rest else 422 field screenshotPath; load state; require state.StudentId==userId; db.SubmitPaymentAsync; OrderDto). TransitionAsync: PaymentReview authorized for vendor owner OR admin; StudentCancel admin allowance ONLY when plan.From is AwaitingPayment/PaymentSubmitted; passes userId.Value as actor.

Tests: six ApplyTransitionAsync_* gained the actor arg (+ p_actor asserted in success body); SubmitPaymentAsync success+FH001+FH002; sync test renamed LegalTransitionSet_matches_sql_whitelist citing 0010 with the exact 9 pairs + all-illegal samples (awaiting_payment->preparing, payment_submitted->ready, awaiting_payment->completed); 4 legal pairs + 3 illegal rows + PaymentReview/StudentCancel classification tests in OrderServiceTransitionTests (audited: none of the 4 new legal pairs were in the illegal list); reason-rule tests in OrderServiceValidationTests (reject-payment requires reason, verify forbids reason); new OrderServicePaymentTests.cs for ValidateSubmitPayment.

Frontend: api.submitPayment(id,{gcashReference,screenshotPath}). Cart copy now says GCash required next (confirm button unchanged, still navigates /order/:id). OrderStatus: fetchOrder select extended (gcash_reference, payment_submitted_at, payment_rejected_reason); STATE_UI + a leading 'Payment' tracker step + DB_STATUS_TO_STEP for both new statuses; awaiting_payment uses full-list getVendor and shows either the payment-details-unavailable message (vendor undefined or !gcashNumber) or the vendor gcashName/gcashNumber (NOT phone) + required reference + optional screenshot (upload to payment-proofs at `${uuid}/${filename}` first, fall back to reference-only on upload error, then submitPayment + refresh); both pre-payment branches render a Cancel order control reusing cancelOrder; rejected-back reason shown; isPending button unchanged; orange/yellow status styles added (no blue). Dashboard: loadOrders select extended (gcash_reference, payment_screenshot_path); new payments bucket; Payments tab with submitted group (Verify->pending / Reject->awaiting_payment / Cancel->cancelled, GCash ref + View screenshot signed URL) and a muted awaiting_payment group (Cancel only); nav badge for submitted count; status styles added. Admin: orders SELECT extended to id,code,...,gcash_reference,payment_screenshot_path; OrdersPanel keyed by o.id (displays o.code), receives onChanged=loadAll + setError, imports transitionOrder, has per-row busy + reason prompts + setError surfacing + onChanged() refresh; payment_submitted -> Screenshot/Verify/Reject/Cancel, awaiting_payment -> Cancel only, others read-only; signed-URL screenshot (null-path message). Admin order writes deliberately go through the C# order service.
